sun_lens.title: The Sun Lens
sun_lens.description: Surveyor Renn vanished beneath the Glass Flats while mapping the old observatory. Sera believes the Mirror Warden is using Renn's lens to focus the desert sun.
sun_lens.objective: Defeat the Mirror Warden in the Sunken Observatory and recover the Sun Lens.

surveyor_notes.title: The Surveyor's Notes
surveyor_notes.description: Ilyan needs Renn's field notes to finish a lens that can read the observatory's buried charts.
surveyor_notes.objective: Recover the Surveyor's Notes from the Sunken Observatory and return them to Ilyan.

shard_bargain.title: A Shard for the Road
shard_bargain.description: A prism shard from the observatory would pay the caravan's debts and keep the road open for another season.
shard_bargain.objective: Recover the Prism Shard from the Sunken Observatory and return it to Sera Voss.
